Her prop firma dört eksende, 5 üzerinden: Each prop firm is scored on four axes out of 5, and the Index score is the 10-point equivalent of the average of these four axes. We use a rubric separate from our broker scoring because a prop firm is not a broker: what we measure here is not leverage or minimum investment, but the passability of the rule set and whether the firm pays out.
Kâr hedefi, günlük ve toplam drawdown or: Profit target, daily and total drawdown rate, whether drawdown is static or trailing, minimum trading days requirement. Trailing drawdown is significantly harder than static drawdown and lowers the score.
Challenge ücreti ve — çoğu karşılaştırma: Challenge fee and — the part that most comparisons skip — when the fee is refunded. A firm that refunds on the first payout is cheaper in terms of real cost than one that refunds on the third payout.
Kâr paylaşımı oranı, ödeme döngüsü ve en: Profit split ratio, payout cycle, and most importantly, verifiable payout history. This axis is also where shutdown risk is measured: a firm with a short operating history loses points here, even if its rules are generous.

Prop firma indirim kodu nedir, ne işe ya: What is a prop firm discount code, and what does it do?
Prop firmalar, değerlendirme (challenge): Prop firms distribute promotional codes providing a discount on evaluation (challenge) fees. The code is usually manually entered into the 'promo code' or 'coupon' field on the checkout screen; in some firms, the discount is directly embedded in the link and no separate code entry is needed. The discount affects only the challenge fee — it does not alter profit splits, drawdown limits, or other rules.
İndirim kodu challenge'ı tekrar alırken: Is the discount code also valid when retaking the challenge?
Bu, prop firma satın alımlarında en çok: This is the most overlooked cost item in prop firm purchases. Since the vast majority of challenges are not passed on the first attempt, your true cost is usually not a single fee, but the sum of several attempts. Whether the code is valid for new purchases and resets varies from firm to firm; you need to check separately on the checkout screen for each purchase.
Neden bazı firmaların indirim kodu yok?: Why do some firms not have discount codes?

Prop firma, trader'a kendi sermayesini r: A prop firm is an entity that provides a trader with the opportunity to trade using company capital without risking their own capital. The trader first passes an examination called a 'challenge' or 'evaluation': they must reach the specified profit target without exceeding the daily and overall loss limits. If successful, they receive a funded account and retain an agreed percentage of the generated profit (typically 75-90%). The challenge fee is paid once and is refunded with the initial payouts at most firms.
Prop firma challenge'ı neden geçilemiyor: Why are prop firm challenges failed?
Challenge başarısızlıklarının büyük çoğu: The vast majority of challenge failures result not from missing profit targets, but from breaching drawdown (loss) limits. There are two separate limits: a daily loss limit (typically 3-5%) and an overall loss limit (typically 6-10%). A single over-leveraged position can trigger both. Therefore, the true test of a challenge is position size management, not directional forecasting: trades entered without calculating lot sizes based on account balance and firm limits are the most common cause of elimination.
1 aşamalı ve 2 aşamalı challenge arasınd: What is the difference between 1-step and 2-step challenges?
2 aşamalı (2-step) modelde iki ayrı fazı: In the 2-step model, you must pass two separate phases; typically, there is an 8-10% profit target in the first phase and 5% in the second phase, with broader drawdown limits (typically 5% daily / 10% overall). In the 1-step model, there is a single phase and you get funded faster, but drawdown limits are noticeably tighter (typically 3% daily / 6% overall). In the instant funding model, there is no challenge; a funded account is purchased directly, though fees are higher and profit splits are generally lower.
Prop firma seçerken en önemli kriter ned: What is the most important criterion when choosing a prop firm?
Ödeme sicili. Kural seti ve ücret önemli: Payout track record. The rule set and fee are important, but generous rules from a firm that fails to pay out are meaningless. Between 2020-2026, over 80 prop firms closed; TrueForexFunds went bankrupt leaving approximately $1.2 million in unpaid payouts, MyFundedFX closed in February 2026, and MyForexFunds was shut down by the CFTC in 2023. Therefore, when selecting a firm, operational history, verifiable proof of payout, and whether a regulated broker backs the firm are far more decisive than discount rates.
Çoğu prop firma copy trading'i açıkça ya: Most prop firms explicitly prohibit copy trading. For example, IC Funded prohibits copy trading and passive investment strategies; it allows EA (automated system) usage provided it does not create 'hyperactivity'. Manually applying signals is technically different from copy trading, but some firms combine both under the same clause. Before using a signal service or copy trading system, you should read the firm's rulebook and preferably obtain written confirmation — rule violation results in the cancellation of the funded account, even if profits have accumulated.

Pozisyon büyüklüğü nasıl çıkar: How position size is worked out
Lot, karar verilecek bir sayı değil, üç: Lot is not a number to decide on, it is the result of three inputs: how much you are risking, how many pips away your stop is, and what one pip is worth on that instrument.
Pozisyon büyüklüğü formülü: risk tutarı,: The position size formula: the risk amount is divided by the stop distance multiplied by the pip value, and the result comes out as a lot. In the example, 1% risk per trade on a 10,000 balance is 100 units; with a 20-pip stop and a pip value of 10 units per lot, the result is 0.50 lots.
Risk/ödül oranı ve başabaş kazanma oranı: Risk/reward ratio and the break-even win rate
Bir oran tek başına iyi ya da kötü değil: A ratio is neither good nor bad on its own. The only thing it says is how many trades have to win for you to break even at that ratio — if your win rate is below that threshold, the ratio will not save you.
Üç risk/ödül oranı yan yana: 1'e 1 oranı: Three risk/reward ratios side by side: to break even, 50% of trades must win at 1:1, 33% at 1:2 and 25% at 1:3. As the reward side grows, the win rate needed falls.
Düşüşün telafisi neden orantısız: Why recovering a drawdown is not proportional
Kayıp yüzdesi küçülen bakiyeden, telafi: The loss percentage is taken off the balance you had; the recovery percentage is earned on the balance that is left. They are not the same number, and the gap widens as the drawdown deepens.
Dört kayıp seviyesi ve telafisi: %10 kay: Four loss levels and their recoveries: a 10% loss needs an 11% gain, 20% needs 25%, 30% needs 43%, and a 50% loss needs 100%. The gain required grows far faster than the loss as the drawdown deepens.
Bekleyen emirler fiyatın neresine konur: Where pending orders are placed relative to price
Dört emir türünün tamamı güncel fiyata g: All four order types are defined relative to the current price. Mixing up which goes where leaves the order waiting on exactly the opposite side from the one you wanted.
Güncel fiyatın üstünde buy stop ve sell: Above the current price sit buy stop and sell limit; below it sit buy limit and sell stop. The upper pair triggers if price moves up, the lower pair if price moves down.
Seanslar ve kesişen saatler: Sessions and the hours they overlap
Üç seans günün farklı saatlerini kaplar: The three sessions cover different hours of the day, and the range where two of them overlap is the most liquid part of it. Liquidity means trading conditions, not direction.
24 saatlik bir zaman çizelgesinde Asya s: On a 24-hour timeline the Asian session covers 03:00–12:00, London 10:00–19:00 and New York 15:00–24:00. The 15:00–19:00 range where London and New York overlap is the busiest part of the day. Times are Türkiye time.
Kaldıraç neyi değiştirir, neyi değiştirm: What leverage changes, and what it does not
Kaldıraç pozisyonun bloke ettiği teminat: Leverage changes the margin a position locks up. It does not change what that same position gains or loses from a one-pip move.
100.000 birimlik aynı pozisyon için 1:30: For the same 100,000-unit position, 3,333 units of margin are locked up at 1:30 leverage, 1,000 at 1:100 and 200 at 1:500. On all three rows a 20-pip move is worth the same amount; the only thing that changes is the margin locked up.
